name: Image Style On Upload
description: Applies an image style on upload.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Summary 
 Applies a configurable image style when uploading image files on the website.

 This can be very handy when you are working with an optimize pipeline on your image style.

When a content editor then adds a big file, the original file will already go through a process of optimisation (typically the width will be reduced - by default an upload image style is added of 2000px width).

 Back to top 

 How to configure 
 After installing and enabling the module, go to: /admin/config/media/image_style_on_upload

Select an image style and configure the mime types of the files that you wish to alter:

 

 Save and export configuration...

 That's all there is to it!
